objective.text: Recompile deployed Blade views without confusing compiled templates with application data.

difficulty.rationale: Clear generated templates without treating user/application cache data as the same cache.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A deployment procedure needs to remove generated compiled Blade templates so they can be rebuilt from the current sources. It must not flush application cache entries such as user counters. Which command targets that artifact?

options.rationale: This removes the route cache, not compiled Blade templates.
options.misconception: This removes the route cache, not compiled Blade templates.

options.rationale: This removes cached configuration, not generated view files.
options.misconception: This removes cached configuration, not generated view files.

options.rationale: view:clear removes compiled view files; it is separate from flushing the application cache store.
That targets the application cache store and can remove the counters the requirement preserves.
